slides.headline: A FOUNDER RAN 6 FREE AI PROMPTS AND MATCHED WHAT HER $8,000 CONSULTANT TOLD HER
1) EXPOSE YOUR PRICING MISTAKES
slides.body: Consultants typically charge around $2,000 for a pricing audit. "Here's what I charge for [products] and what 3 competitors charge. Tell me exactly how much I'm leaving on the table"

slides.headline: 2) GRADE YOUR WEBSITE LIKE A CUSTOMER
slides.body: A web agency can charge $5,000 or more just to tell you what's wrong. "Look at [my website]. Give me the 3 biggest reasons someone leaves without buying and rewrite the first thing they see"

slides.headline: 3) FIND YOUR BIGGEST BOTTLENECK
slides.body: A business consultant can charge $300 an hour for this. "Here's how my business works: [describe it]. Find the single step slowing everything down and how to fix it"

slides.headline: 4) SCORE YOUR MARKETING OUT OF 10
slides.body: Agencies can bill $3,000 a month or more and never say what's failing. "Here are my last 10 posts. Score each 1-10 for engagement and rewrite the lowest one to double its reach"

slides.headline: 5) PREDICT WHEN YOU RUN OUT OF MONEY
slides.body: A part-time finance director can cost $5,000 a month or more. "Here are 3 months of income and expenses. Tell me when I run out of money if nothing changes and what to cut first"

slides.headline: 6) STRESS-TEST YOUR BUSINESS BEFORE REALITY DOES
slides.body: Strategy firms can charge $10,000 or more for this kind of session. "I make money by [describe it]. List the 5 most likely things that kill this business in 12 months and how to prevent each"

slides.headline: SAVE THIS POST
slides.body: You'll want these prompts when you sit down with your real numbers. Save it now. Daily AI news and real skills you can use tonight

caption:
Swipe for all 6 prompts 👇 Each one diagnoses a different part of your business and tells you exactly what's broken

Good consultants charge $5,000 to $15,000 for this kind of diagnostic. These six prompts give you the same hard truths in one sitting. The owners using them fix problems before they cost real money.

hook_tournament.why: The $10,000 number stops my thumb cold — it's a concrete promise I can immediately evaluate and it makes me feel like I'm about to steal something valuable. Shark Tank is vivid and I'd probably swipe on that too, but it tells me the format, not the payoff — '$10k free' tells me both.

hook_sharpen.why: "BRUTAL" lands before your brain even finishes the line — it implies the AI won't coddle you, which hits differently than a dollar figure. $10,000 is a number; brutal is a feeling, and feelings stop thumbs.
